notes.title: Server Expansion and Access Distribution Update (Updated: 6/20 7:30 PDT)
notes.content: [p]Greetings Sentinels,[/p][p][/p][p]To allow more players to join the test, a server expansion work along with additional access will soon take place. [/p][p][/p][p]※ During the preparation phase for the server expansion, queue sessions may be temporarily cleared.[/p][p]※ The server list may not be fully displayed. If this happens, please close the game completely and restart the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Once the preparation is complete, server openings and access distribution will proceed sequentially. [/p][p][/p][p][b][New Servers][/b][/p][p]- NA 7 ~ [strike]30 [/strike] → [b]70[/b][/p][p]- EU 7 ~ [strike]30[/strike] → [b]70[/b][/p][p]- ASIA 13 ~ [strike]30[/strike] → [b]70[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your interest in the Chrono Odyssey Closed Beta.[/p][p]We are committed to providing a smooth and stable testing experience for everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued interest and support![/p]

notes.title: Official Discord & Fandom Wiki Now Open
notes.content:
Chrono Odyssey now has an official home on Discord and Fandom Wiki.

To foster deeper connections with our community, we’ve opened new channels for communication and collaboration! These platforms will serve as a citadel for sharing the vast lore, gameplay knowledge and the latest updates on the game.

[h2]Official Discord Server[/h2]

Join fellow Sentinels in discussing the game and staying up to date on official announcements and events.

[url=https://discord.gg/RxNUeyz4Dv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935330/a1f84068509bd3df3b0cbf25948c5a5278097ee2.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Chrono Odyssey Fandom Wiki[/h2]

Explore the lore and get familiar with the world of Setera. 
Join in and help shape the growing archive!

[url=https://chrono-odyssey.fandom.com/wiki/Chrono_Odyssey_Wiki][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44935330/545836ebbf6859f2a28ff7780539cac34148e3c2.png[/img][/url]

And for those who may have missed it, [b]Playtest sign-ups are open[/b]!
Don’t miss your chance to be among the first to experience the world of Chrono Odyssey.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873440/Chrono_Odyssey/

Thank you.
